properties.decision: Any bulk form over a tool that records a JUDGEMENT carries that judgement per item, never hoisted to a call-level argument: set_artifact_checksums takes a disposition per artifact, acknowledge_gaps a reason per gap, and gaps_to_prompts groups answers per gap. A shared timestamp is allowed because it is a fact about the call; a shared disposition is not, because it would be a shared decision.
properties.name: A bulk form collapses the round trip, never the judgement
properties.rationale: BL-153 stated the trap before the build: "a batch of 144 acknowledgements with one reason is exactly the erosion those decisions exist to prevent, so a bulk form needs per-item dispositions or it is worse than the loop." This is the line that keeps dec:two-sided-accept ("silent drift-accept does not exist") and dec:ask-not-repair true under a bulk surface — 244 accepts now cost one call and still 244 decisions. It is also the distinction that let dec:manifest-derived-is-not-manifest-accepted go the other way and take no per-item disposition at all: a DERIVATION records no judgement, so there is none to preserve. For gaps_to_prompts the per-item grouping is additionally mechanical, not only doctrinal: grouping answers by gap is what stops two gaps' prompt ids colliding, so no gap is ever replayed against another's answers — and a half-answered batch is refused rather than half-served, because serving half would record some questions and silently drop the rest.
